detail.longDescription: Firefox keyboard shortcuts most people don't know but should: Ctrl+Shift+T reopens the last closed tab, Ctrl+1-9 jumps to tabs by position, F9 toggles Reader View, Ctrl+L focuses the address bar without touching the mouse. These five alone significantly reduce mouse usage: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/firefo x-keyboard-shortcuts-worth-actually-memorizing-3mk0 # Firefox # Productivity # Shortcuts
